description: Introduce web_widget_api route macro and stateless package-owned signed-request pipeline. Operation-specific backend proof must cover connector authority, widget/user, timestamp, and nonce; ordinary browser JWT cannot authorize it. Make retries idempotent, commit user cutoff, broadcast scoped revocation, invalidate targeted active sessions/subscriptions, notify browsers and close transports. Show terminal refresh-page message and suppress automatic provider renewal. Add endpoint, race, and browser tests.
title: Add backend disconnect API and router macro
